scene: Through the brass telescope, distant whimsical districts of Pixel City come into view.
picture: A circular first-person telescope view with brass rim and crosshairs. On the far left, a creaky rope-bridge lift basket hangs ready by giant branches. In the centre sits a steaming paddle steamer moored at a brightly lit pier. On the right, a ramped skate-park shuttle van idles with its passenger doors open.
shown: A wooden rope-bridge lift basket hangs suspended on the far left
A colourful paddle steamer with spinning wheel floats docked in the centre
A neon-striped skate-park shuttle van parked waiting on the right
